description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Awoken Spellblade], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quick Cast] and [Lifelong Devotion Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Spellblade
description.text: Spellblade abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Lifelong Devotion Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Lifelong Devotion after using two Spellblade abilities

description.name: Lifelong Devotion
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire] and [Fire +30% Boost 1]/[Fire +50% Boost 1]/[Fire +70% Boost 1] to the user if 0/1/2 of Gordon or Hilda are alive

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%
